translations.name: NJHMFA Foreclosure Prevention counseling
translations.description: NJHMFA's foreclosure prevention counseling is free, with no income test. It is for owners who live in a 1-4 unit home that is in or near default. Call 1-800-654-6873 to be matched to a county counselor. It can take days to 2 weeks.
translations.website_description: Learn about housing and utility help.
